newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African right calls abortion law ethnic cleansing.
newsitem.headline: S.African right calls abortion law ethnic cleansing.

text.p: A white right-wing group condemned draft South African abortion legislation on Tuesday as a plot by the "black English regime" to exterminate Afrikaners.
"The proposed legislation is an attack on the Afrikaner people by the black English regime," the Boerestaat (Afrikaner state) Party said in a statement.
"It is a calculated plan to cut our numbers and as such is nothing short of ethnic cleansing," said the party, which has limited support.
It stands for creation of an independent country within South Africa ruled by Afrikaners, descendants of the Dutch, French and German settlers who began arriving in the 17th Century.
"The party regards doctors who carry out abortions on Afrikaner women as murderers, and they will have to accept the consequences," the statement said.
Conservative apartheid governments banned abortions except under tightly defined circumstances but a bill now before parliament would allow abortion on demand until the 12th week of pregnancy.
